propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a local rebar checkout cannot resolve internal cross-references in packaged guides (consumer-relative paths like review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md fail to resolve)
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) has no CLI-discoverable home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help documents it and no guide references the command

Dangling references in packaged guides must be repointed: sibling guides should use 'rebar explain <topic>' and repo-only docs should use canonical hosted GitHub URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/...)
No packaged guide in _guides/*.md should contain consumer-relative link targets; only https://, http://, intra-doc anchors (#), and mailto: are allowed
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring lists only plan and review guides and must be updated to include commit-trailer
Every 'rebar explain <topic>' citation in packaged guides must reference a real registered guide in AUTHOR_GUIDES
